svg.title: Survey ETL architecture
svg.desc: Clients upload their files to the client portal. The portal connects to SurveyCTO, where the collected records are exported as CSV. AzCopy uploads the CSV to /container9/folder9/data.csv in Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2. The Blob Created event starts the ADF pipeline. Inside Azure Data Factory, the Run monitor tracks the triggered pipeline and its activities. Data Factory uses its Databricks linked service to connect to the workspace and a personal access token (PAT) to authenticate the notebook run request. The Databricks notebook retrieves its storage credential through a Key Vault-backed secret scope, reads the raw CSV, and writes one cleaned CSV part file to updated_data3/. On notebook success, Copy Data reads updated_data3/p* through Azure Integration Runtime, clears dbo.data3, and inserts the rows into that Azure SQL Database table.
